title: Forge overview
description: forge fleet: service, git, storage, replication, anycast/BGP, node. Source: infra/monitoring/grafana/forge-overview.json.

panels.title: Requests/s by scheme and status
panels.description: forge_gemini_requests_total; status is rounded to the decade (20, 30, 40, 50, 60).

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95
panels.description: GeminiLatencyHigh fires at p95 > 2 s for 10m.

panels.title: SSH sessions/s by op and result
Hook decisions (10m increase)
panels.description: forge_hook_decisions_total (planned counter). HookDenialsSpike fires at > 20 non-accept decisions in 10m.

panels.title: Backup age (max)
panels.description: forge_backup_age_seconds; 0 until the backup job populates it. BackupStale fires above 36h.

panels.title: Data filesystem free
panels.description: DiskLow fires below 2 GiB; the health worker drains at limits.min_free_bytes (1 GiB).

panels.title: Replica lag (events behind leader)
panels.description: forge_replica_lag_events{leader}: this node's cursor against the leader's last event id. ReplicaLagHigh fires above 100 for 5m.

panels.title: Announcement state per POP
panels.description: forge_bgp_announced is 1 only in state announced (drained and withdrawn both read 0). forge_healthy is the health worker's last verdict.

panels.title: BIRD BGP sessions
panels.description: bird_protocol_up from bird_exporter; sessions vultr4 / vultr6 per POP.

panels.title: BIRD exported / imported prefixes
panels.description: Expect export 1 while announced, 0 while withdrawn; import 1 (the provider default) whenever the session is up.

panels.title: Reachability: anycast (from the monitoring host)
panels.description: Probes of 44.32.58.1 and 2a0f:85c1:368:1::1 land on the POP nearest to the monitoring host only.

panels.title: Reachability: per node (unicast)
panels.description: Per-POP unicast probes: provider addresses (mesh-independent) and the /48 unicast address (needs the WireGuard backhaul).

panels.title: Announcement changes per hour
panels.description: ForgeFlapping fires at 4 or more changes in 1h.

panels.title: Failed systemd units
panels.description: node_systemd_unit_state{state="failed"}; a failed oneshot (forge-backup, forge-maintenance) stays failed until the next run.
